Rooms.Name: Beginning of the Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
You have wandered onto a narrow dirt path. It appears to be a safe and
passable trail. The path continues to the north.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: A Bend in the Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The trail makes a ninety degree turn, with
exits leading to the south and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You sense small animals darting about in the
trees and tall grass surrounding the trail. Exits lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. To the north you see a small hollow in the
forest. To the south you see a small cave entrance. The dirt path continues to
the east and west.

Exits.Description: A small hollow appears here.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see a small cave entrance.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to a Small Cave
Rooms.Description:
You climb through a small opening in the rock formation to enter the cave.
You can see the exit which is to the north. However, the light from the cave
entrance is small and you can't see beyond the entrance of the cave. The cave
continues to the south.

Exits.Description: Through the cave entrance you can see the dirt path.
It is to dark to see.

Rooms.Name: A Bear's Den
Rooms.Description:
You have found the home of a large Cave Bear. He may not be to pleased that
you have entered uninvited. If you are very quiet, he may not hear you. Exits
lead to the north and west.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the cave lies in this direction.
It is to dark to see.

Rooms.Name: A Bat's Lair
Rooms.Description:
You have gone deeper into the cave. Though you may not see anything
on the ground here, you may want to check above your head. There is an
exit to the east.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Rabbit Hollow
Rooms.Description:
Off the dirt path you have come upon a rabbit hollow. The rabbit's
tend to stay away from the entrance since many travelers often pass
by on the dirt path.

Exits.Description: The rabbit hollow is there.
You can see the dirt path from here.

Rooms.Name: Rabbit Hollow
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the Rabbit Hollow. Here you can see rabbits darting
here and there. Many of the Rabbits are coming and going from the east.
To the south, you can make out the dirt path which lies beyond the
entrance to the Hollow.

Exits.Description: You can see a small hole in the hollow.
You can see the entrance to the Rabbit Hollow.

Rooms.Name: A small hole in the hollow
Rooms.Description:
As you wander deeper into the hollow, you have come upon a small hole. You
imagine that the rabbit's use this as there home. The hole looks just big
enough for you to fit through.

Exits.Description: You can see the Rabbit Hollow where many rabbits frolic and play.
Below you, you see a hole in the ground.

Rooms.Name: The Rabbit Hole
Rooms.Description:
You are now underground. Above you can see opening that leads back up to the
rabbit hollow. To the north there is a small wooden door. A tunnel to the east
leads deeper into the hole.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway to the north.
You can see a tunnel leading to the east.
Through the hole you can see the rabbit hollow.

Rooms.Name: Rabbit storage room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the storage room of the rabbits. However, the rabbits tend
to eat there food more quickly than they can store it. If you are lucky, you
might just find some carrots lying around on the floor.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway to the south.

Rooms.Name: Deeper in the rabbit hole
Rooms.Description:
You are deeper in the rabbit hole now. The only exit from here is to
go back to the west.

Exits.Description: You can see a higher in the rabbit hole.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You feel very safe on the path. As you glance
around, you tremble as you think about what lies off the beaten path. Exits
lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. It is a very calm and peaceful walk. Exits
lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You can see the intersection of two paths ahead.

Rooms.Name: Intersection of the Dirt Paths
Rooms.Description:
You have come upon a crossing of two dirt paths. Paths lead off to the
north, east, and west. To the south, you can see an entrance to a wooded area.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see the entrance to the Bird Sanctuary.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Bird Sanctuary
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the bird sanctuary. Here you can see several different
types of birds all in one small area. You can wander through, just make sure
that you keep you eyes open for those bird bombs.

Exits.Description: You can see an intersection of two dirt paths.
You can see the bird sanctuary to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Bird Sanctuary
Rooms.Description:
This area is heavily wooded so that it will attract many different types of
birds. You hear many different bird calls as you enter. There are thousands of
birds who call this sanctuary home, but you will be lucky to see just a few.

Exits.Description: You can see the entrance to the bird sanctuary.
You can see a thickly wooded area.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You can see a long trail leading to the north.
To the south, you can see an intersection of two paths.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The path leads of to the north and to the
south.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The path leads off to the north and to the
south. To the north-east you can see a mountain. A small opening lies to the
east.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see a small opening which leads into the mountain side.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to a Cave
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a cave. The light from outside shines through the small
opening during the day. You can tell the cave continues to the east, but it is
to dark to see anything.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.
You can see the dirt path through the small opening in the cave entrance.

Rooms.Name: Deeper in the Cave
Rooms.Description:
You are now well within the cave. You are getting an uneasy feeling about
being here and a fleeting thought races through you mind that you should turn
back.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.
You can see the entrance to the cave.

Rooms.Name: Well within the Cave
Rooms.Description:
As you look around, you don't see anything that interests you. Then,
suddenly, in the corner you see a pile of human bones that sends shivers down
your spine.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.
It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: The Grizzly Bear's Lair
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the lair of a huge grizzly bear. If you run now you might
just get away with your life. As far as you can tell, there are no exits other
than the one that you came in through.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. To the east the mountain continues to get
larger and larger. The path leads off to the north and to the south.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The mountain to the east is very large. The
path leads off to the north and to the south.

Exits.Description: A bend in the path lies ahead.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: A Bend in the Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path bends to the west here. To the east you see a steep path up
the side of the mountain. The path does seem to be passable.
   Near the path up the mountain side is a small sign. READ IT!!!

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A path leads up the side of a mountain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small weather beaten sign reads:

              Dangerous CLIFFS!!!
              -------------------
            Climb at your own risk!
          One wrong move and you will
              fall to your death.

Rooms.Name: Mountain Side
Rooms.Description:
You have walked half way up the side of the mountain. You can feel yourself
getting winded. You can go farther up the mountain side or you can go down to
the dirt path.
   There is a sign here.  You feel the that you should READ IT!!!

Exits.Description: You can see the top of the mountain.
You can see the dirt path below.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small weather beaten sign reads:

              Dangerous CLIFFS!!!
              -------------------
          Take care in every step that
          you take. If you don't, your
         next one could be your last...

Rooms.Name: South-West Corner of the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the highest passable point on the mountain. You can follow
the trail which goes around the peak of the mountain, or head back down the
side of the mountain.  There is a small fence here, which is the only thing
that will stop you from falling to your death.

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
Back down the mountain side to safe ground.

Rooms.Name: Trail on Top of the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on the edge of the cliff walking around a narrow trail. The mountain
path continues around the top of the mountain. To the west you can look out
over the beautiful landscape. Just don't look down! There is a small hole in
the fence to the west here. Be very careful, death is only a few feet away.

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
Off of the cliff. You don't want to go this way. But what a view!

Rooms.Name: North-West Corner of the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the north-western corner of the mountain. You can see for
miles and miles. You best not get to caught up in the view, death is only a few
feet away. The small fence is the only thing between you and your death!

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.

Exits.Description: Off of the cliff. You don't want to go this way. But what a view!

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.

Rooms.Description:
You are on the edge of the cliff walking around a narrow trail. The mountain

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small opening in the side of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Lair of the Saber-Tooth Tiger
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the lair of the Saber-Tooth Tiger. It would be wise of you
to climb right back out of here. This Tiger is not one you want to mess with.

Exits.Description: You see a small opening which will take you back onto the mountain trail.

Rooms.Name: South-East Corner of the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the south-eastern corner of the mountain. You can see for
miles and miles. You best not get to caught up in the view, death is only a few
feet away. The small fence has a break in it to the east, so be very very
careful about where you step.

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
Off of the cliff. You don't want to go this way. But what a view!
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: Trail on Top of the Mountain
Rooms.Description:
You are on the edge of the cliff walking around a narrow trail. The mountain

Exits.Description: You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.
You see a small trail that leads around the top of the mountain.

Rooms.Name: The Fall to Death
Rooms.Description:
How's it feel to fly? You watch the beautiful scenery before you as you
tumble towards the ground below. Your life flashes before your eyes.
AAAAAAA
      AAAAAAAA
             AAAAAAAAAAA
                       AAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
                                          HHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
You are dead.

Exits.Description: You see a trail back to safety.
You see a trail back to safety.
You see a trail back to safety.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. The trail continues to the east and
to the west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: End of the Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
You have come to a dead end on the dirt path. You can follow the path
back to the east, or you can be adventurous you can leave the well worn
path and enter the woods to the north. To the south, you see a small
opening in a rock formation.

Exits.Description: There is a small entrance to a heavily wooded area.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see a small opening in a rock formation.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Heavily Wooded Area
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a heavily wooded area. You can hear branches breaking all

Exits.Description: The woods are to thick to see ahead of you.
You can barely make out the dirt path through all the trees.

You are now standing inside the rock formation. You can see the dirt path

Exits.Description: You can see the dirt path through the small crack.
It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: Underground Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Inside the underground tunnel you can see almost nothing. The only light in

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.
It is to dark to see anything.

You are well within the underground tunnel. You can tell by your

It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: Underground Tunnel

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.
It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: Lair of the Giant Weasel
Rooms.Description:
You are at the end of the tunnel. Here you see many carcasses lying
everywhere. Of all the weasels, you can tell that this is where the biggest of
all resides.

Exits.Description: It is to dark to see anything.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You feel as if you don't have a care in the
world as you wander along this peaceful trail. Exits lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: You can see the intersection of two paths ahead.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. This path reminds you of that path you used to
spend all you days on as a child. You feel just so comfortable on it. Exits
lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. You are surrounded to the north and south by
vast fields that allow you to see for miles around. There is no reason for you
to leave the trail however. Exits lead to the east and west.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Dirt Path
Rooms.Description:
The dirt path continues here. Such a nice path don't you think? Exits lead
to the east and west. To the north is the porch of a small farm house.

Exits.Description: A small farm house lies directly to the north.
A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You see an entrance to the pasture again.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Pasture
Rooms.Description:
You have come upon the entrance to a vast pasture. To the south you can see
the entrance to a pig pen. To the west you can see the entrance to a sheep
pasture. All you are sure of is that you don't want to be here any longer than
you have to, because it stinks worse than anything you have ever smelled.

Exits.Description: A narrow dirt path leads in this direction.
You can see a pig pen.
You can see an entrance to a sheep pasture.

Rooms.Name: Pig Pen
Rooms.Description:
You are now in the pig pen. You have heard that pigs are one of the cleanest
animals around, but you are a mess. The exit to the pig pen lies to the north.
The wooden fence around the pen will allow you to go to the south and east.

Exits.Description: You see the exit to the Pig Pen.
You can see farther into the pig pen.
You can see farther into the pig pen.

Rooms.Name: Porch of a Small Farm House
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the porch of the small farm house. A door lies to the
north. You can step off of the porch and onto to the dirt path which lies to
the south.

Exits.Description: You see a doorway which leads into a small farm house.
The dirt path lies in this direction.

Rooms.Name: Foyer of the Farm house
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the foyer of the small farm house. The home is very
rustic. You can see a dining room through a doorway to the west. To the east,
you see a living room. To the north, there is a small doorway. The doorway out
of the house lies to the south.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway to the north.
You can see a living room.
You can see the doorway which leads outside.
You can see the dinning room.

Rooms.Name: The Dining Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in the dinning room of the small home. The antique dinning room set
is absolutely beautiful. There is a small window on the west wall. Through the
window you can see a vast pasture. To the east you can see the foyer of the
small house. To the north lies the kitchen.

Exits.Description: You can see the kitchen.
You can see the foyer in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The kitchen
Rooms.Description:
You are now standing in the kitchen. Hmmm, does it smell good in here! Looks
like an apple pie baking in the oven. On the North wall is a small window that
looks out over the vast plains behind the house. There is a door to the east
here. To the south lies the dinning room.

Exits.Description: You see a doorway.
You can see the dinning room.

Rooms.Name: The Farmer's Daughters Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You are in a quaint little room. Everything in this room is placed ever
so perfectly. There is a picture of the small family on the dresser. There
is a window on the north wall which you can see the vast plains that lie
behind the house.

Exits.Description: You see a doorway.

Rooms.Name: The Living Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the Living room of the small farm house. As you look
around, you feel as though you are in your grandmother's home, since it looks
as though none of the furniture has been replaced in about 40 years. To the
west is the foyer. A door lies to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a dooryway.
You can see the foyer to the small house.

Rooms.Name: The Master Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the master bedroom of the home. As you look around, you
notice that the farmer and his wife might not be the simple people you thought
them to be. You see a set of handcuffs on the night stand next to the bed. To
the south is a door leading out to the living room.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway leading out to the living room.

Rooms.Name: The Bathroom
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the bathroom of the small farm house.  It is an
absolute mess in here. You think that you will wait till you see McDonald's
on your way home so you can stop and use the restroom.  There is a doorway
to the south here.

Exits.Description: You can see a doorway leading out to the foyer of the house.

Mobs.Name: mouse small
Mobs.LongDescription: The small mouse is scampering around here.
Mobs.Description:
The mouse leads a boring existance. However, he seems to be
cheerful and merry as he scampers along the ground.

Mobs.Name: rat rodent
Mobs.LongDescription: The rat scurries along looking for anything to scavenge.
Mobs.Description:
The rat is a long tailed rodent which resembles mice, but is
a little big larger. The rat scurries along the ground.

Mobs.Name: squirrel
Mobs.LongDescription: The squirrel is here collecting nuts.
Mobs.Description:
A brown furry squirrel. The squirrel has a long flexible,
bushy tail. The squirrel is here searching for nuts.

Mobs.Name: raccoon racoon coon
Mobs.LongDescription: The raccoon is here showing little fear of you.
Mobs.Description:
The raccoon has grayish-brown fur with black masklike
facial markings, and a bushy, black-ringed tail.

Mobs.Name: cardinal bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The cardinal is perched on a nearby tree branch.
Mobs.Description:
The cardinal is a beautiful red bird with a
crested head and a short, thick bill.

Mobs.Name: blue jay bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The blue jay is perched on a nearby tree branch.
Mobs.Description:
The blue jay is beautiful bird with a crested head
and predominantly blue plumage.

Mobs.Name: robin bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The robin is perched nearby whistling a delightful song.
Mobs.Description: The robin has a orange breast and a brown back.

Mobs.Name: eagle bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The eagle is resting on a large branch nearby.
Mobs.Description:
The eagle has a powerful hooked bill, long broad
wings, and strong, soaring flight.

Mobs.Name: owl bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The owl is perched here on a nearby branch.
Mobs.Description:
The owl has hooked and feathered talons, a large head with 
short hooked beaks, and eyes set in a frontal facial plane.

Mobs.Name: black crow bird
Mobs.LongDescription: The black crow is here shrieking his raucous call.
Mobs.Description:
The black crow is large glossy, black bird. The crow is
scavenger who will feast on any corpse he encounters.

Mobs.Name: bat
Mobs.LongDescription: The bat is here hanging from the ceiling.
Mobs.Description:
The bat is a nocturnal creature, sleeping all day and only
moving about at night. The bat has membranous wings that extend
from the forelimbs to the hind limbs or tail.

Mobs.Name: cave bear
Mobs.LongDescription: The cave bear is sleeping here in his cave.
Mobs.Description:
The cave bear is about 15 feet tall with reddish brown fur. Cave
bears are harmless when sleeping, but be careful not to wake them.

Mobs.Name: black bear
Mobs.LongDescription: The black bear is here wandering about.
Mobs.Description:
The black bear is about 6 feet tall with dark black fur. Black
bears tend do not attack unless provoked.

Mobs.Name: grizzly bear
Mobs.LongDescription: The grizzly bear is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
The grizzly bear stands about 9 feet tall and has silver-tipped
brown fur. Grizzly bears are fond of meat, however this one looks
as if he has just finished a meal. Lucky for you!

Mobs.Name: wild boar
Mobs.LongDescription: The wild boar is here minding his own business.
Mobs.Description:
The wild boar is an omnivorous creature, but tends to mind its own
business. However, they have extremely nasty tempers when disturbed.

Mobs.Name: mountain lion cat
Mobs.LongDescription: The mountain lion is here wandering around the mountain side.
Mobs.Description:
The mountain lion is a tawny-furred creature. The lion weakest of
the family of the great cats. As many of the creatures in its family,
the mountian lion is a playful creature, but is subject to violent
changes of temper.

Mobs.Name: wild big horn mountain ram
Mobs.ShortDescription: the wild big horn mountain ram
Mobs.LongDescription: The wild big horn mountain ram is moving easily upon the mountain side.
Mobs.Description:
The wild big horn mountain ram has large spiral horns. The ram is long
legged and very agile as you can tell from the way he easily moves up
and down the mountain side.

Mobs.Name: weasel
Mobs.LongDescription: The weasel is here searching for some small prey.
Mobs.Description:
The weasel is a short but long creature, measuring 4 to 5 feet in length.
The look rather harmless, though you do not feel so safe when you see
there sharp teeth.

Mobs.Name: giant weasel
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant weasel is here looking at you hungrily.
Mobs.Description:
The giant weasel looks similar to his smaller counterpart, except for
the fact that he is twice the length, measuring 10 feet in length.
One other thing you notice is that he is much more dangerous looking.

Mobs.Name: sabre tooth tiger cat
Mobs.LongDescription: The Sabre-Tooth Tiger stands peering at his next meal.
Mobs.Description:
The Sabre-Tooth Tiger are larger than most cats in the same family.
You instanly notice the oversized fangs, from which the cat is named.

Mobs.Name: wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The wolf is standing here studying his surroundings.
Mobs.Description:
The wolf is a beautiful animal, resembling that cute puppy you saw last
time you wandered by the pet store. Don't forget that this is a vicous
predator when provoked!

Mobs.Name: goat
Mobs.LongDescription: The goat is standing here nibbling on some grass.
Mobs.Description:
The goat is a rather dull animal. He does little other than wander
around nibbling on grass.

Mobs.Name: sheep
Mobs.LongDescription: The sheep is standing here grazing.
Mobs.Description:
The sheep has a large wool covering over it's body. The sheep also
has split hoofs, making it cloven-footed.

Mobs.Name: cow
Mobs.LongDescription: The cow is standing in the grazing on nearby grass.
Mobs.Description:
The cow is a decent sized animal. He is white with large black
spots all over his body. The cow looks pretty harmless.

Mobs.Name: pig
Mobs.LongDescription: The pig is here playing in the mud.
Mobs.Description:
The pig is a very intelligent animal. Though the pig is not the
world's prettiest animal, he does have some good qualities.

Mobs.Name: horse
Mobs.LongDescription: The horse is standing here tall and proud.
Mobs.Description: The horse is a beautiful animal standing a little of more than 6 feet tall.

Mobs.Name: deer
Mobs.LongDescription: The deer is wandering around.
Mobs.Description:
The deer is a beautiful animal. His antlers raise high above his head.
The deer is a very quick and agile animal.

Mobs.Name: moose
Mobs.LongDescription: The moose is here wandering around looking at his surroundings.
Mobs.Description:
The moose is the largest living deer. The moose has a heavy body,
long legs, and short neck and tail. The moose can move quickly
though his looks would seem to make you believe otherwise.

Mobs.Name: bunny hare rabbit
Mobs.LongDescription: The bunny rabbit is here as cute as ever.
Mobs.Description:
The bunny rabbit is a cute creature which you would like to
pick up and hold. The bunny looks so harmless you feel like
a jerk even thinking about harming it.

Mobs.Name: farmer
Mobs.LongDescription: The Farmer is here thinking about the chores to be done today.
Mobs.Description:
The farmer is a middle aged man. He is of medium height and is
pretty thin. You can tell that he has worked hard on the farm
all his life.

Mobs.Name: farmer wife
Mobs.LongDescription: The farmer's wife is standing here preparing a meal.
Mobs.Description:
The farmer's wife is a well rounded woman. You can tell she has
spent many days in the kitchen.

Mobs.Name: daughter girl
Mobs.LongDescription: The farmer's daughter is standing here looking as hot as ever.
Mobs.Description:
The Farmer's Daughter is one of the most beautiful creatures you have
ever seen in you life. As she notices you looking at her, she gives
you a little wink!
